-- @param tag_name: text
-- @param tag_values_json: text
-- @param authors_json: text
-- @param kinds_json: text
-- @param since: integer
-- @param until: integer
-- @param extra_tag_name: text
-- @param extra_tag_values_json: text
-- @param result_limit: integer
SELECT events.event_json
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT event_id
    FROM event_tags
    WHERE tag_name = ?
      AND tag_value IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
) AS matched_tags
CROSS JOIN events ON events.id = matched_tags.event_id
WHERE TRUE

AND (events.pubkey IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)))

AND (events.kind IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)))

AND (events.created_at >= ?)

AND (events.created_at <= ?)
  AND TRUE
ORDER BY events.created_at DESC, events.id ASC
LIMIT ?;
